notes: Manufacturer spec page (Blackmagic Design, model code W-VASS-04) confirms: 1x SDI in / 1x SDI out (BNC, multi-rate 270Mb-12G, i.e. 12G-SDI capable), 1x HDMI 2.0a in / 1x HDMI 2.0a out, 2x balanced mini XLR audio in with phantom power, 1x 3.5mm headphone out, 1x USB-C 3.1 Gen 1 (for external drive recording), 1x 2.5mm LANC (record start/stop), dual UHS-II SD card slots (not listed as a port — no SD-slot connector id in the allowed enum), and 1x external 12V DC power input (also accepts Sony NP-F style battery plates on the rear). Mini XLR audio jacks and the 2.5mm LANC jack have no exact match in the provided connector enum; mapped to the closest ids (xlr3, trs-3.5 respectively) per instructions. SDI grade set to sdi-12g reflecting the model's top supported rate (also handles lower rates down to SD-SDI). This is a handheld/on-camera monitor-recorder, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. B&H Photo listing (https://www.bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1507213-REG/) corroborates the SDI/HDMI/audio I/O counts from an independent retailer but could not be fetched directly (403); cross-check was via search-result summary only.
